import copy,hashlib,json,pathlib,re,runpy,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/birnam-74ad-cleanup-interactions');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'));ns=runpy.run_path(str(root/'scripts/recovery-graphs.py'));check=ns['check_closure_string_cleanup_matrix'];base=root/'docs/measurements';path=base/'74ad-cleanup-interactions-release-full.json';data=json.loads(path.read_text());check(data);checks=['complete actual release matrix accepted']
def alter(row,field,value,group='collection'):
 row[group][field]=value
 row['stdout']=re.sub(r'\b'+field+r'=\d+',field+'='+str(value),row['stdout'])
def counted_observer(d):return next(r for r in d['rows'] if r['counted'] and r['cleanup']==2)
def exact(d):return next(r for r in d['rows'] if r['counted'] and r['cleanup']==1)
cases=[
 ('quick matrix',lambda d:d.update(quick=True)),
 ('missing row',lambda d:d['rows'].pop()),
 ('duplicate row',lambda d:d['rows'].__setitem__(-1,copy.deepcopy(d['rows'][0]))),
 ('wrong source body',lambda d:d['rows'][0].update(source_sha256='wrong')),
 ('stale source',lambda d:d['sources'].update({'scripts/closure-string-cleanup-smoke.py':'wrong'})),
 ('raw output mismatch',lambda d:counted_observer(d)['collection'].update(callback_live=0)),
 ('rebound callback mismatch',lambda d:alter(counted_observer(d),'callback_live',0)),
 ('unsettled observer',lambda d:alter(counted_observer(d),'settled',0)),
 ('unneeded exact cleanup settlement',lambda d:alter(exact(d),'settled',1)),
 ('String not released',lambda d:alter(exact(d),'string_released',0)),
 ('counting did no work',lambda d:alter(exact(d),'counted_indices',0,'sequence')),
]
for name,mutate in cases:
 d=copy.deepcopy(data);mutate(d)
 try:check(d)
 except RuntimeError as e:checks.append(name+' rejected: '+str(e))
 else:raise AssertionError(name+' accepted')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
result=dict(status='passed',qualified=False,receipt_sha256=sha(path),checker_sha256=sha(root/'scripts/recovery-graphs.py'),checks=checks,audit_source=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),scope='Admission checker tests using the actual completed release receipt and explicit corrupted copies. Not additional runtime cases.')
(base/'74ad-cleanup-admission-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(checks),'admission checks passed')
